name: expense-webapp

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Create, list, edit and withdraw claims; list and decide on team claims; list and export approved claims.

dependencies.name: category-agent
dependencies.description: Get a suggested expense category from the claim's description before submitting.

description: The single web application for all three actors: an employee submits and tracks expense claims, a manager reviews and decides on their team's claims, and finance exports approved claims to payroll. Renders different screens per signed-in role; holds no business logic beyond calling expense-api and category-agent.
